entry.title: A drawer they can investigate
entry.summary: As a baby becomes steadier on their feet, the authors describe an accessible drawer with a few suitable things the adult is happy for them to take out, in a secured space.
entry.cue: Your baby is opening drawers or investigating what is inside.
detail: This gives an ordinary household interest a place. The appendix describes room-related objects, such as kitchen pots and pans, in a cupboard or drawer selected for the baby.
The surrounding movement guidance keeps unsafe cupboards secured and furniture fixed against falling. The objects still need to meet the book’s mouthing, finish and secure-parts conditions.
